scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @runtypelabs/persona typecheck && pnpm --filter @runtypelabs/persona-proxy typecheck && pnpm --filter web typecheck
scripts.test:run: node --test scripts/cdn/*.test.mjs && pnpm check:persona-wire && pnpm --filter @runtypelabs/persona test:run && pnpm --filter @runtypelabs/persona-proxy test:run && pnpm --filter web test:run && pnpm --filter echo-express --filter echo-hono --filter echo-script-tag --filter echo-sveltekit --filter ai-sdk-next --filter eve-next --filter flue-next --filter cloudflare-agents --filter langgraph-next --filter openai-agents-next --filter runtype-hono-proxy --filter bento-slides --filter webmcp-typed-tools test
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:run
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @runtypelabs/persona build:styles && NODE_ENV=development concurrently "pnpm dev:runtype-hono-proxy" "pnpm dev:widget"
scripts.release:build: pnpm build && pnpm exec changeset pack --out-dir .release-packages && pnpm exec changeset publish --from-pack-dir .release-packages
